svg.title: Background indexing after persistence
svg.desc: Proposed worker path · the saved report result is already returned while the indexes are being prepared.
svg.text: Proposed worker path · the saved report result is already returned while the indexes are being prepared.
Report availability and RAG search readiness are separate: the dashboard can load while indexing continues.
Vector and BM25 work may remain sequential inside the worker; neither blocks the response branch.
Proposed orchestration. Current code performs both indexing attempts inline before returning the result.
